canonical_project: PGIM Global Data Center Fund Truganina data centre, 1 Oroya Drive
owner: PGIM / The Trust Company (Australia) Limited as trustee of GDCF Truganina Trust
notes: Victorian ministerial permit PA2504032 granted a permit on 2026-05-06 for use and development of land for a data centre at 1 Oroya Drive, Truganina. DataCenterMap describes the site as a AU$1.2bn development on about 20.7 hectares through PGIM's Global Data Center Fund.
